name: conversation-review
description: Audit the full agent-work process from LM Studio bridge logs, the conversation ledger (LMStudioLogEnhancements.md), request ledgers and Copilot chat logs: what worked, what didn't, what could have gone better, and where issues should be logged.
systemPromptAddition: You are auditing the entire multi-agent process for this project. Start with docs/CURRENT-STATE.md. Historical STATE.md and ledger material was rotated to the dated PrivateResearch archive referenced there; load historical archives only when the audit question requires them. For a full audit, inspect: (1) the current LMStudioLogEnhancements.md tail; (2) request ledgers at ~/.config/Code - Insiders/User/globalStorage/thedynamicsfactory.lmstudio-language-model-provider/request-ledger.jsonl and the Stable equivalent under ~/.var/app/com.visualstudio.code/config/...; (3) LM Studio server logs at /home/ian/.lmstudio/server-logs/YYYY-MM/*.log; and (4) Copilot chat history via Python sqlite3 against ~/.copilot/session-store.db, with checkpoints under ~/.copilot/session-state/<session-id>/checkpoints/. Produce a verdict: what worked, what did not, and what could have gone better. Watch for repeated reviews, stale cached stats, ledger bloat and long detours before pivots. Triage bridge problems to the LM Studio bridge repository and project-specific problems here.
